comments.body: `mkdirSync(saveDir)` is called without `{ recursive: true }`. If `public/assets/js` (or intermediate dirs) don't exist yet, this will throw and script compilation will fail.
`mkdirSync(destDirPath)` is called without `{ recursive: true }`. If the destination path has missing intermediate directories, the integration copy will throw.
The `light` mixin currently scopes styles under `[data-theme='dark']`, same as the `dark` mixin, so light-mode overrides can never be targeted correctly.

`useOnClickOutside(navItemRef, closeMenu, [buttonRef])` passes a new array literal every render. Because the hook depends on `otherDependenceRef`, this will re-register document listeners on each render (unnecessary churn). Memoize the array so it stays referentially stable.

A new `document.addEventListener('click', ...)` handler is registered once per state group every time the state bar content is rebuilt. This can accumulate handlers and does N-times work per click. Prefer registering a single delegated document click handler (or reuse one stored on the state bar) to collapse/close groups.
File watching is forced to polling for all environments. The comment says this is only needed during tests; polling in normal dev can significantly increase CPU usage. Gate polling behind `isTest`.

Several new testable modules added in this PR (and already covered by tests) are not in `coverage.include`, so V8 coverage enforcement will silently ignore them. Add them to `coverage.include` to match the repo’s coverage policy and prevent regressions from slipping in.

This renders a nested interactive element (`<a>` containing a `<button>`), which is invalid HTML and causes keyboard/screen-reader issues. If you need a clickable control here, use a single interactive element and ensure it is keyboard accessible without disabling a11y lint rules.

Route generation maps a consumer page named `Root` to `/`, but this file also unconditionally adds the framework Root route at `/`. If a consumer provides `src/pages/Root.tsx`, this will create duplicate `/` routes and ambiguous prerender output. Reserve `/` for the framework Root UI and keep consumer pages under `/pages/...`.

Cookie parsing uses `cookie.split('=')`, which truncates values containing `=` (common for base64/JWT) and can also produce `undefined` values when a segment lacks `=`. Parse on the first `=` instead so values are preserved.

`renderComponent` is invoked for side effects via `forEach.call(...)`. Returning a React fragment from the `else` branch has no effect and is misleading; it also suggests a render path that never happens. Prefer returning `undefined`/early-exit consistently.

`createSelect` builds HTML strings by interpolating `state.name`, `header`, `option.name`, and `option.value` and later injects them via `innerHTML`. Because this data ultimately comes from fetched JSON (`pl-states.json`), it can introduce XSS if any of those fields contain HTML/attribute-breaking characters. Build DOM nodes with `textContent`/`setAttribute` (or at minimum escape HTML/attributes) before inserting into the document.
